title: YOU DECIDE
content:
An exhibition on decisions and how to save the World.

This is the new open-source platform for the "You Decide" exhibition.
All exhibits are modular. You can download the parts and info here, rebuild them, or improve them.
The exhibition — and this website — will keep changing with you and us.

Here you find general information and materials on the exhibition "You Decide"

subsections.title: Libet Experiment
subsections.content:
The brain "presses the button" before you believe you have made the decision.

In the Libet experiment, it was shown that the brain's motor system begins preparing a movement before a person becomes consciously aware that they have decided to execute that movement immediately. The time gap is about 0.35 seconds, and the actual movement then occurs roughly another 0.2 seconds later.

[wikipedia.org/wiki/Libet-Experiment](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Libet-Experiment)

subsections.title: The Coin
subsections.content: Each week, we place a game coin in a jewelry case. Guests can choose whether to leave the coin or take it with them. If the coin remains until the end of the week, we donate CHF 50 to a charitable project – otherwise, we do not.

subsections.title: Findings
subsections.content:
- The play coin never remains in the box until the end of the week.
- As soon as the play coin is gone, visitors place their own real coins into the casket.
- We remove these coins each time; however, new ones are continually placed inside.
- Some visitors even hide coins under the padding in the case.

title: SYSTEM
content: Here you find the information and materials on the construciton system used througout the exhibition.

subsections.title: GRID
subsections.content: The grid system is based on a modular design with a 157 mm grid and a 9 mm margin. The system panels are milled from 19 mm pine and feature Ø30 mm grid holes. They are compatible with the item D30 system for expansion.
